summary: Tested Entrance (one-shot) animations end-to-end. Backend (pytest 3/3 passing): PUT/GET /api/scenes persists props.entrance, entranceDuration, entranceDelay alongside continuous animation/animationDuration; overlay HTML at /api/public/scene/{token}/overlay contains all 6 entrance @keyframes (clara-in-fade/up/down/left/right/zoom), entranceAnim() + retriggerEntrance() helpers, references clara-in-up for slide-up preset, uses 'both' fill mode, and preserves clara-pulse on the inner wrapper (independent from entrance). Frontend (Playwright): MFA login OK, Scene Editor Properties panel shows 'Entrance (plays once)' select (prop-entrance) with 7 options none/fade/slide-up/slide-down/slide-left/slide-right/zoom; choosing fade reveals prop-entrance-dur + prop-entrance-delay sliders and canvas outer wrapper style.animation contains 'clara-in-fade'; picking slide-up produces clara-in-up, zoom produces clara-in-zoom. Both entrance + continuous (pulse) animations run independently on separate wrappers (verified two distinct style.animation values). Save (save-scene-btn) + reload persists entrance='zoom'. Regression: prop-animation and prop-anim-speed still work; el-output-url + copy-el-output present per-element. No issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: SceneEditor: prop-entrance-dur/prop-entrance-delay use plain HTML <input type=range>; consistent with prop-anim-speed but consider shadcn Slider for consistency with rest of app (minor).
OVERLAY_HTML: entranceAnim() defaults entranceDuration to 0.6 and entranceDelay to 0; matches frontend defaults (0.6 / 0) — good. Verify parity if defaults ever change.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 scene 'TEST_Entrance_UI' via UI and 1 scene 'TEST_Entrance_Scene' via pytest — both cleaned up (plus 2 leftover TEST_Entrance_UI scenes from earlier runs cleaned via API).
